_note: Site settings read by tools/build-meta.mjs. site_url = canonical production origin: sitemap.xml, robots.txt, <link rel=canonical>, og:url and og:image are derived from it. Publication switch: Unpublished pages: removed from nav/footer (wrapped in <template>), noindex, out of the sitemap, reachable by direct URL only. Flip published to true and run npm run build.
_prototype_note: Prototype for the chairman preview: every page noindex,nofollow; robots.txt Disallow: /; X-Robots-Tag: noindex (frontend/_headers). REMOVE before the real site launches (BRAND_GAPS G41).
